properties.summary: Action: China's Targeting of the Maritime, Logistics, and Shipbuilding Sectors for Dominance To allow for further discussion with China regarding the acts, policies, and practices at issue in this investigation, the U.S. Trade Representative (Trade Representative) is modifying the action taken in this investigation to further suspend that action for two months, until January 10, 2027. Later dates named in its DATES paragraph: 2027-01-09. Federal Register document 2026-22867.

properties.summary: Action: Notice. The United States Trade Representative (Trade Representative) has determined to extend for three months the ongoing Section 301 investigation of certain acts, policies, and practices of the Government of Vietnam related to intellectual property (IP) protection and enforcement. Effective 2026-11-03. Federal Register document 2026-22868.

properties.summary: Action: Notice. In prior notices, the U.S. Trade Representative (Trade Representative) modified the actions in the Section 301 investigation of China's acts, policies, and practices related to technology transfer, intellectual property, and innovation by excluding from additional duties certain products of China. While most exclusions have expired in prior years, certain exclusions remain in force. This notice announces the Trade Representative's determination to further extend all 178 current exclusions. Later dates named in its DATES paragraph: 2027-01-09. Federal Register document 2026-22925.
properties.title: USTR notice (2026-11-10): Notice of Product Exclusion Extensions: China's Acts, Policies, and Practices Related to Technology Transfer, Intellectual Property, and Innovation

BIS rule (2026-11-25): Additions to the Entity List
properties.summary: Action: Final rule. In this rule, the Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) amends the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) by adding 7 entities to the Entity List, under the destinations of Malaysia, Singapore, and Thailand. These entities have been determined by the U.S. Government to be acting contrary to the national security or foreign policy interests of the United States. Effective 2026-11-23. Federal Register document 2026-23999.
